description: This file implements a GStreamer element called GstRialtoDecryptor, which is responsible for decrypting media buffers within a GStreamer pipeline. It includes class definitions, method implementations for decryption, and factory functions for creating decryptor elements. The code interacts with external decryption services, manages protection metadata, and handles buffer processing in-place.
